speaker: Doctor

That is excellent. Regarding the large ovarian mass, have you experienced any pelvic pain or bloating in addition to the increased abdominal girth?

REQUEST TEST: CA-125, LDH, HCG, CEA, AFP.
REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic Ultrasound, CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast, CT Chest.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CA-125: Normal Level; LDH: NORMAL READINGS; HCG: NORMAL READINGS; CEA: NORMAL READINGS; AFP: NORMAL READINGS. Pelvic Ultrasound: Large mass in the right ovary; CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast: Large right ovarian mass, significant ascites present; CT Chest: Right-sided pleural effusion.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Cancer with Malignant Pleural Effusion and Ascites.

The combination of a large right ovarian mass, significant ascites, and a right-sided pleural effusion, despite normal tumor markers (CA-125, CEA, AFP, HCG, LDH), is highly suggestive of advanced epithelial ovarian cancer. The normal CA-125 is unusual but can occur in early stages or specific histologic subtypes like mucinous tumors or Brenner tumors, though the clinical picture strongly favors a malignant process requiring surgical staging and histopathological confirmation. Given the pleural effusion, I would recommend a thoracentesis for cytology to confirm malignant cells.
